description: Terminal-blocked notifyOrchestrator sites in the supervisor loop narrate the supervisor's block outcome instead of the worker's self-reported (possibly DONE) summary.

userStories.title: Narrate supervisor block outcome at terminal-blocked notify sites
userStories.description: As an operator watching the orchestrator pane, I need the terminal-blocked notifications to reflect the supervisor's BLOCK decision so that the pane never shows '[cam] US-XXX DONE' for a story the supervisor actually blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: Every terminal-blocked notifyOrchestrator call in the implement branch of src/supervisor/loop.ts narrates the supervisor's terminal outcome via lastOutcome.detail (the non-optional WorkerOutcome detail string) at ALL SIX sites regardless of outcome kind, NOT formatWorkerReportSummary(report). The narration MUST NOT be gated on lastOutcome.kind==='blocked': sites ~949 (kind fail/unknown) and ~996 (kind incomplete) reach the terminal-blocked return with a non-'blocked' kind (set via `lastOutcome = outcome` at loop.ts:876) and must be narrated too, or the fix is silently incomplete. The six current sites are: push-verification-failed, outcome blocked/fail/unknown, finalize-aborted-gates-failed, finalize-failed, incomplete, and the no-progress block. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

A behavioral test drives the implement branch to a terminal-blocked state (e.g. an injected readWorkerReport returning a BLOCKED_QUALITY report, OR a report with outcome:'DONE' paired with prd/handoff state that yields outcome.kind blocked/incomplete) and asserts the line captured by the injected notifyOrchestrator reflects BLOCK and does NOT equal formatWorkerReportSummary on a DONE report. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]

A behavioral test confirms that when the injected worker report self-reports outcome:'DONE' but the supervisor reaches a blocked terminal, the narrated line does not contain the substring 'DONE' (it carries the block detail instead). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]

The blocked-narration string reuses the existing '[cam] ... BLOCKED' precedent style already used by the review-error path (opts.notifyOrchestrator(`[cam] review BLOCKED: ${detail}`) at the review branch) rather than inventing a new unrelated format; no new exported formatter is added unless an existing one is reused. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The happy-path narration sites are unchanged: the genuine-advance pass notify, the supervisor-finalized-pass continue notify, and the PRD_COMPLETE notify still call formatWorkerReportSummary(report). A test asserts a genuine DONE advance still narrates the worker-report summary line. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]
The review-branch notify sites (formatReviewVerdictLine verdict line, MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT line, '[cam] review BLOCKED:' line) are untouched. [oracle: grep -q 'review BLOCKED' src/supervisor/loop.ts]

A file-assert guard discriminates fixed-from-current code: the terminal-blocked branches no longer call formatWorkerReportSummary, so the count of formatWorkerReportSummary call sites in src/supervisor/loop.ts drops from its current value (only the surviving happy-path sites remain). [oracle: file-assert: bun test asserts grep count of 'formatWorkerReportSummary(' call sites in src/supervisor/loop.ts equals the post-fix happy-path count; verify the grep discriminates because formatWorkerReportSummary is also used on happy paths]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint passes and the full quality spine is green (bun run check:all). [oracle: named-command bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: File: src/supervisor/loop.ts (implement branch only). The six terminal-blocked notify sites currently use the idiom `{ const r = readWorkerReport?.(); if (r) opts.notifyOrchestrator?.(formatWorkerReportSummary(r)); }` immediately before a `notifyTerminal('blocked'); return { status: 'blocked', ... }` (approx lines 937, 949, 967, 978, 996, 1028 in the current file; find the real sites, line numbers drift). At each, the local `lastOutcome` has already been set (either to an explicit `{ kind: 'blocked', storyId, detail }` at the push/finalize/no-progress sites, OR to the raw worker outcome via `lastOutcome = outcome` at loop.ts:876). IMPORTANT: sites ~949 and ~996 reach the terminal-blocked return with lastOutcome.kind = fail/unknown (949) or incomplete (996), NOT 'blocked'. Narrate `lastOutcome.detail` at ALL SIX sites regardless of kind -- detail is non-optional on WorkerOutcome so it is always present; do NOT gate the narration on kind==='blocked' or sites 949/996 would be silently skipped and the fix left incomplete. DO NOT touch the three happy-path uses of formatWorkerReportSummary: the supervisor-finalized-pass `continue` (approx line 991), the genuine-advance else-branch (approx line 1047), and the PRD_COMPLETE branch (approx line 1057). DO NOT touch the review branch (formatReviewVerdictLine at approx 1125/1157, '[cam] review BLOCKED:' at approx 1096). Precedent for the block string format: the review-error path at approx line 1096 already does `opts.notifyOrchestrator?.(`[cam] review BLOCKED: ${blockedDetail}`)` -- mirror that `[cam] ... BLOCKED: <detail>` shape using lastOutcome.detail; do not invent a novel format and do not add a new exported helper unless reusing one. WorkerOutcome shape (src/supervisor/result.ts): { kind: 'pass'|'incomplete'|'fail'|'blocked'|'unknown'; storyId?: string; detail: string } -- detail is non-optional. Test harness: test/supervisor/loop.test.ts (makeBaseOpts, makeInMemoryEventLogger, WorkerReport import) already drives the implement branch to blocked via an injected readWorkerReport returning a BLOCKED_QUALITY report (see the existing 'outcome-fallback' / 'outcome-source (D) BLOCKED' tests around lines 2186-2217 and 2412-2429) -- mirror that exact pattern and additionally inject notifyOrchestrator to capture the narrated line. The load-bearing oracle is BEHAVIORAL (drive-to-blocked + assert narration); the grep-count guard is only a secondary discriminator. CI gate: `bun run check:all` (scripts/check-all.ts) runs typecheck + biome lint (--error-on-warnings) + tests; a loop.ts edit can pass `bun test` locally yet fail CI on biome, so run check:all before declaring done. Gotcha (memory: comms-architecture-structured-handback): capture-pane reads RENDERED markdown, so tests must capture the line via the injected notifyOrchestrator callback (as test/supervisor/notify-orchestrator.test.ts does), never by parsing pane text. Keep scope to this single file + its test; do not refactor unrelated narration.
